messages.subject: Re: Vimcom and long command
messages.body_plain:
I have this problem too. I'm using the latest version of the plugin (Vim-R-plugin 1.2.6) with vimcom 1.2-6, tmux 1.9 in xterm.

Also, when browsing long commands in the command history at the R prompt with the up and down arrows or reverse-i-search, things get very messed up. The prompt disappears and in stead an empty line appears, the cursor and part of the previous long command currently being browsed is shown one line up, replacing whatever was shown there before. Continuing browsing will thus erase previous input and output. Issuing a command with RETURN will run it, but it is often hard to tell which command that is because text is so messed up. The cursor is also not indicating where you are editing a command, in stead you are editing invisible text one line below. After running a command, you get your normal R prompt back, but not the input/output that has been erased. The prompt will than typically be half way up your tmux pane whereas it first was at the bottom.

NOTE: the problem does not occur, it seems, when the tmux pane with R console is less than about 80 characters wide.

messages.subject: First characters of command are lost when sent to R console
messages.subject_clean: First characters of command are lost when sent to R console
messages.body_plain:
Often, but not always, the first few characters of a command sent from vim to the R console with Vim-R-plugin are lost. This happens when I send a line with <SPACE> or ,l, or when sending more lines with base::source. In the latter case typically only
se::source("/tmp/r-plugin-daan/Rsource-1031") gets sent. R will than complain it doesn't know the package "se". The number of (non-white space) characters lost seems to increase with the indentation of the line sent.

Any fixes for this?

I'm using the latest version of the plugin (Vim-R-plugin 1.2.6) with vimcom 1.2-6, tmux 1.9 in xterm.

messages.subject: Bracket mismatch indicated when there is none.
messages.subject_clean: Bracket mismatch indicated when there is none.
messages.body_plain:
Parenthesis and curly braces get highlighted in red indicating there are no matching brackets when in fact there are. These highlights may appear when just navigating the code without changing it. Navigating the cursor over the incorrectly highlighted brackets (again without changing any text) often removes the highlights.

Is there a fox for this? Can I in the mean time just turn of the highlighting mismatching brackets feature?

I'm using the latest version of the plugin (Vim-R-plugin 1.2.6) with vimcom 1.2-6, tmux 1.9 in xterm.

messages.subject: Re: Vimcom and long command
messages.body_plain:
Thanks for the detailed description! Now, I can replicate the bug with xterm and Tmux 1.8. There is no problem with LXTerm. I did the following to see the bug:
Put in the vimrc: vimrplugin_term = "xterm"
Started GVim, started editing an R file and started R
Wrote a long line in the R script
Dragged the lateral of the xterm window to make it wider than 80 characters
Sent the long line
However, I don't know how to solve the bug. Perhaps there is either a xterm or a tmux configuration that avoids the bug.
